app.title: Review board
gate.title: Gate
gate.none: The gate has not run yet. Run it from the terminal with profile-wrap gate, or press Allow.
council.title: Council
history.title: History
posts.empty.title: No drafts yet
posts.empty.body: Ask Claude to build a week, or run profile-wrap build-week. Drafts appear here when they exist.
posts.pick: Pick a post on the left to preview it.
detail.degraded: Some files for this draft could not be read. Showing what is readable.
actions.title: Decision
actions.reject.hint: Press again to reject. The post will not be posted.
actions.improve.noworker: No Claude worker is available on this machine.
msg.improve: Note received. A worker is on it.
err.bad_slug: That is not a valid draft name.
err.not_allowed_from_status: That action is not possible in the current status of the post.
err.gate_failed: The gate did not pass, so it was not queued.
err.council_missing: The council has not reviewed this draft yet.
err.council_not_passed: The council has not passed this draft.
err.paused: Everything is paused, so no worker will start.
err.worker_unavailable: No Claude worker is available on this machine.
err.busy: Another write holds the lock. Try again in a moment.
err.worker_forbidden: A worker can never allow a post.
err.not_waiting: That person is not waiting any more.
err.not_pending: That comment is not waiting any more.
err.forbidden: This page is out of date. Reload it.
warn.no_schedule: No scheduled time is set, so nothing will post until you set one.
warn.past_missed_window: The scheduled time is past the missed window.
warn.bad_schedule: The scheduled time is not valid.
banner.stale: This page is out of date (the board was restarted). Nothing was saved. Reload to continue.
banner.paused: Paused: {kinds}. Jobs and API calls are stopped.
banner.degraded: {n} file(s) could not be read. The affected drafts are marked.
banner.config: The config could not be read: {problem}
copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it by hand.
comments.empty.title: Nothing waiting
comments.empty.body: Draft comments and replies appear here. Copy one, post it on LinkedIn yourself, then press Done.
connect.empty.title: No one is waiting
connect.empty.body: The shortlist holds at most {n} people. LinkedIn invitations are sent by you, never by this tool.
profile.empty.title: No profile audit yet
profile.empty.body: This tab lists the steps to fix your profile. Create an audit first, then build the steps:
profile.open.refused: The link for this step was not a linkedin.com address, so it is not shown.
metrics.none: No metrics imported yet. Run profile-wrap metrics import.
metrics.col.title: Post
settings.kill.body: Stops every job and API call at once. Nothing is lost; resume when ready.
settings.acks.how: Accept a risk text in the terminal with profile-wrap config ack.
